scenicChapters.title: Passu → Khunjerab Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 153 km. 4693 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Khunjerab Pass → Tashkurgan
